scope: Technical tokenizer compatibility before any main run or Mistral pilot. No prompt, model, sampling, outcome or scientific-design change.
reason: Mistral encodes an isolated digit as an empty-prefix token followed by the actual digit token; the prior exact-one-token encoding check would reject it.
decision: Select the unique encoded token that individually decodes to the requested digit. Continue to force one output token from0/1. Llama,Qwen,Gemma token IDs are unchanged.
existing_data: Llama pilot already completed and Qwen pilot running with unchanged token choices; both remain valid technical pilots and are never pooled into main data. No Mistral or main data existed.
